# HWHDRActive <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWHDRActive:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 if the window is shown in HDR, else 0.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

A BlitzLLVM extension: tells whether the window is shown in HDR right now, which is when [SetGraphicsHDR](SetGraphicsHDR) is on and the swapchain that it needs was made. It changes at the [Flip](Flip) after SetGraphicsHDR or the display changed.
